description: Scope boundary for doctor's reverse plist-drift check (_factory_plist_drift_checks). The forward direction asks 'was a committed plist edited without reinstalling?'. The reverse asks 'is every installed launchd job that runs this repo's code reproducible FROM this repo?' — the direction that was blind when five Order Samurai jobs ran with no source plist at all (audit 2026-09-01, finding B5).
rule: Every installed com.agentica.*.plist whose ProgramArguments name a path under this checkout must have a source under Governance/automation/launchd/ or Governance/bin/. One WARN per plist that does not, unless its label is acknowledged below.

acknowledged_unsourced.reason: Owner-triaged 2026-09-01 (audit B5): these jobs run repo code but are owned by lanes outside the Order Samurai production-readiness milestone. They are WAIVERS: doctor does not WARN on them, so calling them 'not excused' would be inaccurate. They are not hidden either — doctor names every one of them in a factory.plist-acknowledged row on every run, and warns if an acknowledged label stops being installed. Adopting one is a matter of committing its source and deleting the entry here. Anything NOT on this list warns immediately, which is what makes a newly hand-installed job visible.
acknowledged_unsourced.review: Revisit when the owning lane next touches its scheduling; the entries are not permanent exemptions.
